dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: ... I see.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: So you've seen this shroud before. Have I got that right?
The Floor Manager I met down on B2F was a relaxed, easygoing... "person." That was the impression I got, anyway.

He smelled faintly of stale cigarette smoke, and where one arm should've been, he had this ugly thing that looked an awful lot like an insect's leg. It put me off a little, sure, but by Grand Magasin standards? I figured I'd be fine.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: Uh, yeah... I'm pretty sure I have.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Good, good. That's a weight off my mind... It means He still wears the shroud I made for Him.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: Wait, you made it? That's funny... I could've sworn they said the Skein Nest spins nothing but thread all season.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: That's what I came for, actually. Some thread to sew my piece together...

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Don't you worry, you've come to the right place. And whoever told you that had it right, too. A few seasons back, thread was the whole business that made this place go 'round.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Nothing stopping me from taking your order right now... So. What is it you want?
I'd heard something else about him, too.
Word was the B2F Floor Manager didn't charge a separate fee for spinning. If there was anything he asked in return...

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: I just have to tell you how badly I want the thread, right?

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: *puff* You've gotta love a rumor. Off it goes on its rounds of the Grand Magasin, and I don't so much as have to put a foot outside this room.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Saves me the legwork. Bit of a nuisance, having to go around explaining how we work when I've got a wheel to turn...

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: ... Um, so am I supposed to start talking now, or...?

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Hm? Oh, my bad. Been doing all the talking myself, haven't I?

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Hmm. Mind you, though...

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: What you're yearning for right now is the truth about this shroud, isn't it? Look at how your eyes light up.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Huh. I take it word hasn't gotten around about how I actually spin the stuff?

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: That's the pity about rumors. They get into every nook and cranny, but don't bring much substance beyond that. Try spinning one that makes it all the way down here, and you'd be too ashamed to even call the result thread.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: So gimme a real story—the real deal, y'know, squirming with so much want and yearning that it spills over! Something you desire so badly you'd sooner wring your own neck than go without it...!

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: ... That's how you get thread that'll hold. And the shine of it, too.
... Think I'll scratch out the "relaxed and easygoing" part from my earlier impression.
He inched closer, increasing the weight of his words with each step and subsequent syllable. And the closer he got, the more apparent the mad, wild gleam in his eyes became, picking away at me.
A few seasons ago, that would've been enough to send me scurrying scared back the way I'd come. But...

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: ... You're right. I do feel that kind of yearning about my work, but there's more to it.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: You see, I can't just leave my curiosity alone. I wanna know how you know that... person they call the Crimson God now. And how somebody who only ever spun thread came to make an actual garment.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: See, that's the whole point of what I'm making. Whenever I find the answer to something I've wondered about, I make a fitting that shows what I learned and attach it to the piece. That's how it comes together, I guess. Each virtue added, one fitting at a time.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: So this is one more thing... I really need you to answer.
... He gave a low chuckle and leaned in until his face was right up against mine.
Then he said:

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: ... Two-ply.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: That yearning of yours... I'll be spinning you a two-ply thread. That's good. Very good...

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: So, two strands, twisted together... twice?

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Why, did you need single-ply for whatever you're making? Nah... I don't think you do.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Far as I can tell, you've got more than one yearning in you. Follow any one of 'em back, though, and it all comes down to the one big thing—you wanna finish that garment you've been putting together.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: That's where this curiosity of yours stems from, isn't it? Well, then... this in-progress work of yours calls for two-ply at the very least. Tell me if I'm wide of the mark.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: Actually, I was going to ask your advice about all that, too...

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: But hearing you talk, I can see how that kind of thread would suit what I'm making.
I guess that was what I wanted, after all. A desire of my own, you might say.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: ... As for me, well.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Used to be I'd sit here in my nest, spinning thread and listening to whatever stories came my way. Not much else to it.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: I had the Voice of Fate talking me through it. Where to start, how to go about it, the thread to spin... always there to tell me what I ought to spin next.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Couldn't complain, really.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Still, I felt like I was missing something the whole time I went through the motions.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: I mean, what're threads for? You put one through a needle and stitch something with it. Or you weave them together and make cloth. Right?

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Only, that's not what the Voice of Fate had in store for me. Never did. Some days I'd catch myself hoping to hear, "Make some cloth today," but no revelation like that ever came my way.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Then one day... I met Him.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: He who deigned to come all the way down here.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: The Crimson God...!

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: You should've seen the thread I spun from His yearning. It was radiant. It shone... pure gold.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Something caught fire in me. Never felt anything like it, mind you. I couldn't help but ask myself the question: just how ecstatic would it be to make an actual outfit out of that thread?!

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: And that's when He spoke to me.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: "Let desire have its way. Follow your desires..."

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: "... and do as you have yearned," he said. He said that when the urge to consume comes calling, we're to let it have its way.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: And that he'd very much like to wear whatever came of it.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: So that's what brought you over to Le Rouge.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: That's about the size of it. Them Le Noir folks've been longtime customers of my shop, but their Obsidian God...? I couldn't name one thing in this department store he wants.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: I could turn my hand to anything, make whatever I liked, and he'd just... accept that it exists. Seriously, no more to it than that. A god who comes across like a stranger, if you catch my drift. Can't blame a fella for following somebody who actually wants the goods, can you?

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Now and then I'll run up another Golden Shroud, same as the one I made that day. My way of marking the occasion. Thought it'd be nice to give Him a new shroud one day, seeing as the one He's got is due to start fading. Look at the shine on this...

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: ... Oh? So that's the look you get in your eyes when your yearning's been met, huh.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Good. Plenty there for me to work with. Suppose it's time for me to get wheeling, then.
I hadn't told him the first thing about the thread I wanted. Still, when he headed for his wheel, I didn't hold him back to make my request.
"Eccentric" would be an understatement, but for some equally odd reason, I had the feeling he knew things about what I yearned for that even I hadn't figured out myself yet.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Now, then... Tell me a bit more about that yearning of yours. This is the part where I start twisting the strands together.

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: And, uh, right—there's favor I'd like to ask while you're at it.
... Grrrkk... *scree*

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Things of eld. They're definitely gonna turn up to hinder my work soon if they hear the wheel spinning.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: Got it. I'd better lend a hand, then.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: I think that way, I can showcase my yearning better.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: It's still a work-in-progress, though...

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: ... *whistle* Would you look at that! Now that's one heck of a "piece" indeed!

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Keep going! Tell me all about it. No need to stop cutting them down on my account. Let all of it loose!

dataList.title: Le Rouge
dataList.content: Show me that passion, that desire... the fire of the yearning.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: Um, okay. This is a little embarrassing, but... I guess a proper introduction is in order.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: I call this piece...
